title: Seplat Energy — 9M 2026 Financial Results
supports: Aku-01 discovered oil and gas after period end; preliminary internal mid-case estimates are 157 Bcf gas in place and 19 MMbbls oil in place; completion and a future tie-back are planned; Seplat holds 40% operated interest in PPL 2A25.
limitation: Company-reported preliminary in-place estimates are not proved reserves, production volumes, revenue, a final investment decision, or a schedule guarantee.

title: Seplat Energy — OML 53 operations
supports: OML 53 is an onshore Imo State block of about 1,585 km² with existing oil and gas infrastructure, a 40% Seplat working interest, and links to the ANOH gas system.
limitation: The page describes the wider licence and existing fields; it does not identify Aku-01's exact wellhead or establish effects in any named community.

title: ANOH Gas Processing Company — network entry agreement
supports: The Imo-based ANOH plant has 300 MMscf/d processing capacity and a 2026 agreement enabling up to 250 MMscf/d injection into the national gas network.
limitation: This does not prove that Aku-01 gas will enter ANOH, when it might do so, or at what volume.

title: Nigeria National Bureau of Statistics — Annual Labour Force Survey
supports: For the survey period, Imo State had 2,009,039 employed people, 77.6% self-employment among employed people, 93.9% informal employment, and 12.8% employment in agriculture.
limitation: Survey estimates describe the state and period, not a particular household, community, applicant, or future oil-and-gas workforce.

title: NCDMB — Human Capacity Development
supports: Nigeria's content framework requires employment and training plans for qualifying industry projects and describes classroom, practical, on-the-job and certification pathways.
limitation: A national framework does not guarantee training, contracting, or employment from Aku-01 to any person or locality.

title: NUPRC — Host Communities Development Regulations 2022
supports: Regulations govern determination of host communities, development trusts, needs assessments, development plans, governance and fund distribution.
limitation: Without the regulator/operator's determination and the exact operational area, Atlas cannot name Aku-01 host communities or promise trust benefits.

title: Nigeria Petroleum Industry Act 2021
supports: The Act provides for host-community development trusts and an annual settlor contribution equal to 3% of the preceding year's actual operating expenditure for upstream operations affecting applicable host communities.
limitation: The formula is not 3% of oil revenue and cannot be converted into an Aku-01 community amount without applicable operations and expenditure.

title: NUPRC — Health, safety and environmental oversight
supports: NUPRC reviews environmental impact assessments, risk registers and management plans and monitors upstream environmental action plans.
limitation: Regulatory requirements do not establish that an Aku-01 impact has occurred or that a specific mitigation outcome is assured.

title: NUPRC — Gas Flaring and Venting Regulations 2022
supports: The regulations aim to reduce environmental and social impacts from flaring and venting, protect the environment, prevent waste and create benefits from gas capture.
limitation: They do not establish Aku-01's future emissions, processing route or compliance performance.
